"skillfully follow the link to open the printable version, then fill the Sudoku grid using the digits 1 to 9, making sure each digit appears only once in every row, column, and 3×3 box.

The puzzle offers a refreshing mental climate, encouraging logical thinking as you work through the challenge.

Think of each number as a small gas of possibility that temporarily fills a cell, and notice how a sudden twist in strategy can shift the weight of the puzzle toward completion.

When you are ready, buy next week’s Observer Digital Edition to view the finished solution and compare your work."
